span.p: G-14 Open Item — Consumer Credential Model (Tier 3 Blocker)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2 requires engine to call Compute API
in a CUSTOMER-OWNED subscription.
Option A: Managed Identity + RBAC delegation
Customer grants VM Contributor during onboarding
Option B: Cross-tenant service principal
Higher friction — requires tenant consent
Must be resolved before Tier 3 can be built

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: VMSS — Phase 1 Limitation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
VMSS entries in vm_disassociation_list
→ REJECTED by engine (validation error)
VMSS model requires single ARM call
affecting all instances — higher blast radius
Operators must coordinate manually
Future iteration: dedicated VMSS path (G-13)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Post-Loop State Update

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 4: Expand DR CRG quantity
PUT .../capacityReservationGroups/{dr_crg}/
capacityReservations/{dr_cr}
Body: sku.capacity = dr_crg_qty + freed_slots
Poll: provisioningState == Succeeded

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 5: Update engine state
RegionalSnapshot:
dr_crg_quantity += freed_slots
dr_crg_free_slots += freed_slots
dr_crg_coverage_ratio recalculated
nonprod_crg_quantity -= freed_slots
nonprod_crg_effective_free recalculated
QuotaGroup (NonProdDR):
dr_quota_used_vcpu += freed_slots × vCPU
nonprod_quota_used_vcpu -= freed_slots × vCPU

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 6: Post-transfer audit alert
Alert: EmergencyCapacityTransferCompleted
Severity: Critical (DR audit record)
Payload: slots_transferred, VMs_impacted,
RTO_duration_minutes, correlation_id,
path_a_fallbacks (count), quota_neutral: false

Tier 3 — VM Disassociation Sequence
Dual approval confirmed
vm_disassociation_list validated

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sort vm_disassociation_list
Dev → Test → Staging
(within tier: smallest vCPU first)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: FOR EACH vm IN ordered list

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 1: Reduce Provider CR quantity → 0
PUT .../capacityReservationGroups/{crg}/
capacityReservations/{cr}
Body: sku.capacity = 0
Poll: provisioningState == Succeeded
VM continues running — no customer downtime

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 2: Clear Consumer VM CRG reference
PUT .../virtualMachines/{vm_name}
Body: capacityReservationGroup: null
Poll: GET VM → confirm CRG == null
VM continues running — CR SLA guarantee removed
⚠ Requires engine credentials in consumer subscription
(G-14 open item — Tier 3 implementation blocker)
